subject: test: stop re-downloading the shared test model in CLI/Endpoints jobs (#4254)
summary: Replaces the 183 MB shared test model (Tiny-Test-Model-GGUF) with a 37 MB reranker model (jina-reranker-v1-tiny-en-GGUF) in tests that pull and delete models — test_007, test_008, test_016, cli test_090, and ollama test_099 — so the shared model stays downloaded and CI jobs download ~768 MB less total per run.
verdict_reason: CI-only test optimization reviewed by a maintainer with CI expertise, with all checks passing and no user-visible changes.
